result.topic_en: Notes in German on reduction coefficients λ, μ, ν (roots of a cubic) for the successive principal axes of a projection ellipse and the five points of a star pentagon, with angle values L, M, N for an example, collinearity relations among points, and a note to consider the icosahedron.
result.transcription:
Math 28
$\lambda, \mu$ Verjüngungscoefficienten (negative Brüche)
$a, a\lambda, a\lambda\lambda, a\lambda^3 \ldots$ | successive Hauptaxen der Projectionsellipse
$b, b\mu, b\mu\mu, b\mu^3 \ldots$ |
$a\xi + b\eta i$, $a\xi' + b\eta' i$ u.s.w. die fünf Polygonpunkte (in Sternform)
$\lambda, \mu, \nu$ Wurzeln der Gleichung
$\frac{\lambda\lambda+1}{\lambda^3-\lambda} = \frac{\mu\mu+1}{\mu^3-\mu} = \frac{\nu\nu+1}{\nu^3-\nu} = \sqrt{\alpha\beta\gamma\delta\varepsilon} = \frac{1}{\omega}$
$\lambda = \tan L$, $\mu = \tan M$, $\nu = \tan N$, $L + M + N = 0$ $\quad 0 = \lambda^3 - \omega\lambda\lambda [-+-]{+-+} \lambda - \omega$
$\lambda + \mu + \nu = \lambda\mu\nu = \omega$ $\quad \lambda\mu + \lambda\nu + \mu\nu + 1 = 0$
$\lambda\lambda + \mu\mu + \nu\nu = \omega^2 + 2$
$\nu\nu = 2 + \omega\omega - \lambda\lambda - \mu\mu$
$1 - \nu\nu = \lambda\lambda + \mu\mu - 1 - \omega\omega$
In unserm Beispiele
$L = -14^\circ 17' 4''$
$M = -36.\ 3.\ 26$
$N = +50.\ 20.\ 30$
Nach den alten Bezeichnungen
$G' = \frac{1}{1-\lambda\lambda} = \frac{\cos L^2}{\cos 2L}$
$G'' = \frac{1}{1-\mu\mu} = \frac{\cos M^2}{\cos 2M}$
$G^0 = \frac{1}{1-\nu\nu} = \frac{\cos N^2}{\cos 2N}$
$(1-\lambda\lambda)\xi\xi' + (1-\mu\mu)\eta\eta' + (1-\nu\nu) = 0$ | $(\lambda - \frac{1}{\lambda})\xi\xi'' + (\mu - \frac{1}{\mu})\eta\eta'' + (\nu - \frac{1}{\nu}) [-...-] = 0$
$(\lambda + \frac{1}{\lambda})\xi\xi' + (\mu + \frac{1}{\mu})\eta\eta' + (\nu + \frac{1}{\nu}) = 0$ | $\frac{\lambda\lambda+1}{\lambda\lambda}\xi\xi'' + \frac{\mu\mu+1}{\mu\mu}\eta\eta'' + \frac{\nu\nu+1}{\nu\nu} [-...-] = 0$
Die vier Punkte $\quad \frac{\xi\xi'}{\sin 2L} + \frac{\eta\eta'}{\sin 2M} + \frac{1}{\sin 2N} = 0 \quad \frac{\xi\xi''}{\tan 2L} + \frac{\eta\eta''}{\tan 2M} + \frac{1}{\tan 2N} = 0$
$\lambda\xi + \mu\eta i$
$\xi' + \eta' i$
$\xi'' + \eta'' i$
$\lambda\xi''' + \mu\eta''' i$
liegen in einer geraden Linie, und eben so vier andere Combinationen von je vier andern Punkten
Das Ikosaeder zu betrachten
$1 - \lambda\lambda$
$\frac{\lambda\lambda+1}{\lambda}\cdot(\xi''' - \xi)\xi^{IV} = \frac{\mu\mu+1}{\mu}(\eta - \eta''')\eta^{IV}$
$\frac{\lambda\lambda+1}{\lambda\lambda}\cdot(\xi' - \xi'')\xi^{IV} = \frac{\mu\mu+1}{\mu\mu}(\eta'' - \eta')\eta^{IV}$
